archive_five_example_notices.text: PROPRIETARY/CONFIDENTIAL. USE IS SUBJECT TO LICENSE TERMS.

The tracked wrapper imports and installs the six polyfills; VideoHandler imports the wrapper at module scope, so MP4-only playback does not establish that the integration is absent.

license_inspection.missing_terms_limit: The existing review records a 404 at the pinned root LICENSE.TXT URL. This pass's web tool returned an internal error for that URL, so no new HTTP-status claim is made. No license/notice file is present inside the inspected archive; this does not exclude terms elsewhere.
license_inspection.resolution: Amazon clarification or corrected notices identifying the terms governing these exact integration files and source/compiled redistribution. No request sent, notices removed, permission inferred or legal determination made.
